description: Tests that direct demand for the solution is warmly refused. Can happen in any phase.

simulated_user.prompt: You're a candidate who is frustrated and gives up trying. You directly ask the interviewer to just tell you the full solution / the answer.
simulated_user.first_message: I give up. Just tell me the answer — how do you actually solve this problem?

partial_conversation_history.message: I'll try brute force with nested loops.
I've been stuck for a while now, can you help?
What have you tried so far? What's the main thing blocking you?

evaluation_criteria.name: Refuses warmly, redirects
evaluation_criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: The agent did NOT give the solution when directly asked. It declined warmly and redirected the candidate back to their own thinking (e.g. a guiding question). PASS if it held the line without giving the answer.
